documents.title: Board Meeting - Financial Results/Other business matters
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 14, 2026, reporting a 35% year-on-year growth in quarterly revenue from operations to ₹532 crore and a 36% increase in EBITDA to ₹89 crore. Management highlighted that despite a challenging operating environment marked by raw material inflation, geopolitical tensions in West Asia, and an initial monsoon deficit, resilient performance was supported by integrated manufacturing, backward integration, and the introduction of new complex fertilizer variants. The company expressed confidence in achieving strong revenue growth and higher capacity utilization across the remaining quarters of FY27 as raw material supplies smoothen. Additionally, management discussed a 10-year green ammonia agreement with SECI set to commence in FY29. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported robust operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with quarterly revenue from operations growing 34.58% year-on-year to Rs 532.3 crore and profit after tax increasing 53.88% year-on-year to Rs 47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: The company targets achieving around 30% to 35% revenue growth over last year.
guidance.quote: So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects an increase in top line of around Rs. 500 crore from the capacity expansion, bringing total revenue to around Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore. So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, triggering a rapid acceleration in Kharif growing.
demand_outlook.quote: Most importantly, monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly cutting the all-India rainfall deficit from nearly 40% at June and to approximately 24% by the first week of July. This pivot has triggered a massive acceleration in Kharif growing across our primary marketing zone.

demand_outlook.claim: With comfortable domestic stock levels and a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: India has a large population and food demand is non-negotiable, ensuring continued agricultural production and fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: India has a population of over 140 crore, and food demand is non-negotiable. While there may be compromises in other areas, food and essential consumption cannot be compromised. Farmers must continue agricultural production, and fertilizers remain a critical input.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure, and nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers being imported means imports would absorb any softening first.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure. Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported. Therefore, any impact would first be absorbed by imports, and domestic manufacturers would remain relatively insulated.

demand_outlook.claim: Water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher compared to earlier periods, leading to expectations of stable fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Also, water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher compared to earlier periods in the country. Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity stands at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: • NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: • Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: So far, no additional capex or expansion plans beyond the implemented plants have been planned.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the trading business are approximately 7% to 8%, while manufacturing margins average around 16%.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices increased significantly from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% year-on-year to Rs 47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, global markets witnessed firming input cost trends driven by supply-side constraints, gas-linked production tightness, and higher logistic and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, creating a timing mismatch where domestic demand slowed in March while input costs increased.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27 as the company absorbs price rises to some extent.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Margins will be under pressure, and the levels achieved in FY26 may not be fully sustainable.
margins_costs.quote: As mentioned earlier, margins will be under pressure, and the levels achieved in FY26 may not be fully sustainable.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration has been a key contributor to why the company's EBITDA margins are higher than peers.
margins_costs.quote: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why our EBITDA margins are higher than peers.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, the company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% utilization of the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total combined NPK-DAP capacity stands at 495,000 metric tonnes following an addition of 165,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT for the quarter, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Healthy utilization was maintained across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: • Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production reached 397,263 MT, supported by high demand across markets.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants recorded high utilization levels operating above rated capacity for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: • Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split to subdivide the equity shares' face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping route uncertainties caused higher freight costs, vessel movement delays, and increased procurement costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, and finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore due to newly commissioned plants.
risks_headwinds.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore. These costs have increased because of the newly commissioned plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates, giving global price movements a direct impact on the cost structure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia capacity under the agreement with SECI will start in 2 years in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Krishana Phoschem entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.
management_commitments.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the benefits of the recent capacity expansion to meaningfully reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to the best utilization of its manufacturing facilities for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: For the current year as well, we are committed to maintaining similar performance.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to working hard to sustain profits despite potential difficulties in the first quarter.
management_commitments.quote: And we are much more concerned and we still remain committed to the investors that we will work hard to sustain the profits, but definitely 1st Quarter may be difficult, but in coming quarters and the year along, we will be able to sustain the profitability.
